_comment: Stand-in for B1's comparable-listing scraper. Each entry is the price band
the same kind of object fetches on open marketplaces today, which is the
number the wage floor gets compared against.
lst_9f8a2e1c4b3d is deliberately a band that sits UNDER its wage floor.
A single hand-made diya really does sell for 60-150 rupees online, and three
hours of work at the West Bengal minimum wage plus 50 rupees of clay cannot
be covered by that. The buyer surfaces have to have something honest to say
when that happens, so the seed data makes sure the case is always on screen.
lst_8f30d5b1ae62 is the partial case: the band straddles the floor, so the
bottom of the market underpays and the top does not.
